facts: Shokin told us he is aiming for first place and plans to show everyone the rear view of his car all day.
He named Dustin as his main rival, saying they always compete and play enough one together.
He predicts Dustin will be too aggressive and crash into the wall.
He has been away working on other projects and is shaking off the rust after a long time out of the seat.
For the Samurai, he always eats sushi before the race as his ritual for success.
